Prompt 4 is the hardening and intelligence quality layer. It activates the Critic Agent globally — every agent output now passes through a quality firewall before reaching any user or system. It wires the AutoGen Debate Loop for high-stakes decisions. It activates the Internal Stability Engine (S14) to prevent cognitive chaos as agents scale. It activates Deep Meta-Cognition (S15) — Bhudhi begins tracking its own reliability. All existing prompt contract fallbacks are hardened. When Prompt 4 is complete, Bhudhi is stable enough to handle real user traffic.
THREE LAWS RESTATEMENT FOR THIS PROMPT
The Critic Agent reviews agent outputs. It can REJECT outputs that would violate the Three Laws. It cannot approve system state changes — it can only block outputs that attempt them.

The Debate Loop produces recommendations — the highest-confidence path from multi-agent reasoning. Recommendations still route through governance for blueprint changes and through the Control Engine for task generation. The debate loop cannot shortcut enforcement.

The Stability Engine is a runtime supervisor — not an agent. It has no AI calls. It enforces rate limits, breaks infinite loops, and throttles output density. It cannot override governance decisions or system rules.
